Commentary.Commentary: So that wraps the T20I series as Sri Lanka win it 2-1! Australia will start their campaign of the 4-match Test series against India from tomorrow. On the other hand, the Islanders head back home to host Bangladesh for a long tour. Until then, it's goodbye from us. Take care and cheers!

Sri Lanka skipper, Upul Tharanga says that he is happy with the performance of his team after a tough tour in South Africa. Praises Asela Gunaratne for his performances in this as well as the South Africa tour. Says that the youngsters like Gunaratne and Dickwella are stepping up and it is a positive sign for the future of Sri Lankan cricket.

Australian skipper, Aaron Finch feels that they played some fantastic cricket in this match. Also feels good with his batting performance today. Applauds Klinger for batting well from the other end. Adds that he is happy by ending the series on a high. Ends by applauding his players for their performance today.

Man of the Series, Asela Gunaratne says that it's his first time in Australia and enjoyed every bit of it. On the win in Geelong, he says that he wanted to stay till the last ball and he is happy that he achieved the victory.

Man of the Match, Adam Zampa feels it is nice to pick up wickets but would like to be a regular starter for his country. Reckons that it is good being a leg spinner as they do manage to pick up wickets. Feels disappointed after the series loss and that they need to perform better. Ends by saying that his team needs to keep climbing up the spots in this format.

No one apart from Munaweera at the start and Siriwardana at the end, stood up for the Islanders. Adam Zampa after dropping Munaweera in the beginning redeemed himself by picking a 3-fer and starting the Lankan collapse. Faulkner with another solid performance with the ball scalped 3 wickets. Overall, it was an all-round performance from the Aussies which led them to victory.

Australia finally win a match in the series and do it in style. First they put up a great total on the board with some superb batting from their top order. They set a target of 188 in front of the Lankans which in the end proved to be too much for them. The visitors' openers started in a great fashion. They crossed the 40-run mark under 4 overs and were looking set to chase the total down. But, just then the skipper holed out to Faulkner!

OUT! Sanjaya is run out! Length delivery outside off, cut over backward point. Ben Dunk in the deep cuts it off by moving to his right and hurls a throw at the striker's end. Sanjaya is coming for the second but the throw is a good one. Paine collects the ball calmly and removes the bails. It is referred upstairs and the replays show that Sanjaya failed to make it back in time. That's it for Sri Lanka as AUSTRALIA WIN BY 41 RUNS!
The umpires have gone upstairs for a run out appeal against Vikum Sanjaya. It seems pretty close to the naked eye.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Umpire has a look at the ball as Finch has a problem with the shape of it. After having a look at it, he cuts some extra thread off it.
FOUR! Tennis-ball shot! Length delivery outside off, Vikum taps it into the turf over the extra-cover fielder for a boundary.
On the pads, clipped through square leg for a single.
Vikum Sanjaya is the last man in.

OUT! Direct hit from the skipper! Full outside off, driven to mid off. Malinga takes off for a single. Finch at mid off takes an aim at the bowler's end and hits the target. Malinga is running as if he is having a jog in the park. The umpire refers it upstairs and the replays show that Malinga is well short of his ground. Just a wicket shy of the victory!
The umpire has gone upstairs for a run out appeal against Lasith Malinga.
Malinga makes room and pushes the delivery to covers.
Pat Cummins is back into the attack.
Back of a length delivery, punched off the back foot back to the bowler.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Length delivery outside off, played through point for a single.
Lasith Malinga makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! In the air... gone! Slower delivery on the fuller side, Siriwardana goes  for a big slog but top edges it high in the air. Faulkner places himself under it near the silly mid on region and takes a simple catch. The end is near for SL now! Australia are 2 wickets shy of a victory.
Length delivery outside off, Milinda swings his bat hard but misses.
Slow yorker aimed at the boots, Siriwardana does extremely well to dig it out through covers for a brace.
Full around off, eased onto long off for a single.
A touch shorter, punched to long on for a single.
FOUR! Full in the line of the stumps, Kulasekara drives it powerfully straight down the ground. The ball ricochets off the stumps and goes away to the long off fence for a boundary.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
SIX! Back of a length delivery, angling away, Milinda gets into the position early and heaves it over mid-wicket for a huge maximum.
Wide! Banged in short, Milinda ducks and the umpire signals it as a wide.
Slower one, NK adjusts well to play it through point for a single.
Jhye Richardson is back for a bowl.

Leg bye! Angling into the pads, Nuwan misses his flick and gets it off the pads on the off side. Faulkner and co. appeal but it is turned down. A leg bye is taken. The replay show that the ball was going on to miss the leg stump.
Nuwan Kulasekara is the next man in.

OUT! Faulkner strikes! Back of a length slower one, Prasanna goes for another drag-pull. But, this time finds Richardson in the deep, who takes an easy reverse cup catch. The Kangaroos are cruising through the Lankan batting. 68 required off 31 deliveries!
Wide outside off, Siriwardana slices it through point. The ball just falls short of Head at point, who does well to stop it on the bounce.
Angling away from the southpaw, played to point for a single.
Wide! Down the leg side, Seekkuge looks to tickle it but misses. Wide is signalled!
FOUR! Back of a length delivery, angling down leg, SP drags it over backward square leg for a boundary.
Dabbed to point for a single.
James Faulkner is called back into the attack.
FOUR! Short and outside off. Prasanna cuts it through the gap between short third man and backward point for a boundary.
On the pads, clipped on the leg side for a single.
Outside off, MS goes for a reverse sweep but misses and gets hit on the gloves.
Fuller in the line of the stumps, swept through square leg for a single.
Tossed up outside off, eased onto long off for a single.
SIX! Some shot that! Tossed up outside off, Siriwardana lofts it over extra covers and the ball goes into the stands for a maximum!

Back of a length delivery outside off, Seekkuge looks to cut it but gets it off the outside edge just short of the man at point. The ball travels towards the fence and the batsmen run through for a couple. The replays show that Prasanna limped while running!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Wide! Banged in short, Prasanna ducks and a wide is signaled.
Back of a length delivery, defended from within the crease.
On the pads, worked down the leg side for a single.
FOUR! A touch back of a length delivery, Milinda heaves it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length delivery, angling away, Pat backs a touch and plays it to cover-point.
Pat Cummins comes back into the attack.
Seekkuge Prasanna will bat at number 8.

OUT! 3-fer for Zampa! Slider outside off, sliding in with the angle. Shanaka goes back and looks to play it across the line but gets beaten by the pace. Gets rapped up on the pads, the players appeal and the umpire obliges. The replays show that it is a harsh call as the impact was outside off.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Dasun Shanaka walks out in the middle.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Wrong 'un, Chamara fails to pick it. Goes for an off drive and is beaten by the ball spinning the other way. The ball goes onto hit the timber. SL in trouble now! They need 97 runs more off 41 deliveries!
Tossed up on off, eased onto long off for a single.
Outside off, spinning away, Siriwardana goes for a slog sweep but he is beaten by the away spin.
Short delivery, pulled through front of square on the leg side for  a couple.
Gets it off the inner half of the bat to long on for a single.
Full on middle and leg, swept through backward square leg for a single.
FOUR! Superb stuff! CK goes for a premeditated reverse sweep and gets it past point for a boundary.
Flatter and quicker in the line of the stumps, driven hard straight back. Ricochets towards the man at long on. Single taken!
Angling away from Chamara, he runs it down through third man. A spirited effort at the edge of the circle saves run for his team. A single taken!
Wide! Down the leg side, Kapugedera looks to play it over short fine leg but misses. Wide is signalled!
Full outside off, Siriwardana backs away and drives it through cover-point for a single.

Dropped! Outside off, Siriwardana goes for a square drive but he gets an outside edge which flies towards the point region. Moises Henriques jumps full stretch to reach it as he gets his hand to it. He cannot hold onto it as the batsmen run a quick single.
Tossed up, Kapugedara drives it towards long on for a single.
Kapugedara pushes the first ball he faces towards point.
Chamara Kapugedera is the new man!

OUT! Zampa gets the big wicket. Quicker and the slider on the off stump, Gunaratne goes to play it on the leg side but he is beaten by the pace as he gets rapped on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger up. Gunaratne has to walk back and Sri Lanka need 112 runs more to win off 63 balls.
On the pads, Siriwardane sweeps it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Spinning away from a length on middle and leg, Siriwardane goes to defend it but he beaten by the away spin.
Change of ends for Adam Zampa!
Siriwardana reaches to the pitch of the delivery and drives it towards long off for a single.
Floated outside off, Gunaratne goes for a slash but gets an outside edge which flies through the vacant slip region for a triple.
Siriwardana stays deep in his crease and punches it through covers for a single.
Outside off, Siriwardana cuts it towards the fielder at point.
Floated outside off, Gunaratne guides it towards third man for a single.
Milinda Siriwardana walks in at no.5!

OUT! Fuller delivery into the stumps, Munaweera stays in his crease and goes for a heave on the leg side. The ball goes towards the long on region. Ashton Turner goes back a bit and judges the ball to perfection to take a fine catch. A good knock by Munaweera comes to an end.
Travis Head is into the attack now!
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
Almost drags it on! Outside off on a length, Gunaratne goes to poke at it and he finds an inside edge and the ball just misses the stumps and the keeper collects it.
Outside off, Munaweera cuts it through the point region for a single.
The in-form Asela Gunaratne walks out in the middle!

OUT! Full delivery into the stumps, Kusal stays in his crease and slogs it towards deep mid-wicket. Pat Cummins on the boundary does not have to move an inch as the ball comes straight to him. Mendis has to walk back. 120 required off 75 deliveries!
Outside off back of a length, Munaweera cuts it past the point region for a single.
On the pads, Mendis tries to go for the scoop and gets a single towards short fine leg.
Another bowling change as Jhye Richardson is brought back into the attack!
The batsman has driven it through mid-on. One run added to the total.

In the air....falls short! Tossed up, Kusal camps back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. Faulkner rushes in and dives forward to reach it but the ball falls way short. It has managed to reach the fence.
Short delivery outside off, Munaweera cuts it past the point region for a single.
Tossed up outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
Ball hits the batsman low on the pads.
Munaweera pushes it back to the bowler.
Adam Zampa is straightaway introduced into the attack after the end of the Powerplay!

Good length delivery outside off, Munaweera cuts it towards the fielder at point and they run for a single. The point fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end and he hits it but the batsman has reached well in time.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Fuller delivery outside off, Munaweera drives it down the ground through the mid off region for a boundary.
FOUR! Angled into the pads, Munaweera pulls it through the backward square leg region for a boundary.
Outside off on a good length, Dilshan dances down the track and tries to smack it over the cover region but he cannot make contact with the ball.
Good length delivery outside off, Munaweera goes for a cut shot but he misses it completely.
Angling into the stumps, Kusal clips it on the leg side towards mid on for a quick single.
Moises Henriques to bowl the last over of the Powerplay!
Short delivery in the line of the stumps, Mendis pulls it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
FOUR! Tossed up outside off, Mendis reaches to the pitch of the ball and smacks it over the mid off region for a boundary.
Munaweera does not get his scoop right. He goes for a predetermined shot but fails to middle it. The ball tickes away towards the fielder at short fine leg for a single.
Dilshan stays deep in his crease and pushes it towards the fielder at covers.
Short delivery and Mendis pulls it through the square leg region for a single.
Mendis stays deep in his crease and pushes it back to the bowler.
Ashton Turner is back on!
Good length delivery outside off, Mendis goes for a cut but he gets an outside edge which runs down towards third man for a single.
The batsman has nudged the ball fine down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Kusal Mendis walks in at no.3!

OUT! FAULKNER STRIKES! Short delivery into the body, Upul goes for the pull again but this time cannot find the distance. The ball goes straight to the fielder at deep mid-wicket for a simple catch. Richardson does not make a mistake and grabs it. Faulkner draws first blood and the skipper has to walk back.
Slower delivery, yorker into the stumps. Tharanga manages to stick it out.
SIX! The skipper is now in action! Fuller delivery into the stumps, Upul Tharanga just lofts it over the wide mid on region. The ball has managed to go the distance for a maximum.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
James Faulkner is into the attack now!
Again down the leg side, Dilshan clips it fine for a couple.
Munaweera stays deep in his crease and defends it.
WIDE! Dug in short, Munaweera gets out of the line of the delivery and the umpire signals it a wide.
Leg bye! On the pads, Tharanga misses his flick and gets hit on his pads. The ball ricochets towards square leg and the batsmen run a single.
On the pads, Tharanga clips it on the leg side for a leg side.
Upul Tharanga is beaten there as he tries to poke at a delivery outside off.

Dropped! Short delivery into the body, Dilshan goes for a romp shot but fails to get the distance. The ball flies towards Zampa at third man for a simple catch. He misjudges it and drops it which paranoids the bowler. The batsmen take a single in the process.
Pat Cummins will bowl the next over.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Tharanga mistimes his pull shot through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
The batsman has flat-batted that through the point region. One run added to the total.
Wide! Down the leg side. Munaweera still goes for it but misses. The umpire signalled it as a wide.
FOUR! Munaweera stays in his crease and hits the fuller length delivery over the mid on region for a boundary. He is taking the charge to the bowlers.
SIX! ANOTHER BIGGIE! Munaweera stays in his crease and makes the ball sprayed on the pads pay the price. That was just flicked over the mid-wicket region for a maximum. Superb batting!
Fuller delivery down the leg side, Munaweera tries to clip it but the ball sneaks it between the bat and the body.
SIX! SMACK! Good length delivery outside off, Munaweera stays in his crease and flat bats it over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Jhye Richardson will share the new ball.
Into the pads, Tharanga tries to clip it on the leg side but misses. He gets hit high on his pads and the players appeal. The umpire says no as as the ball was going down leg.
Into the pads, Tharanga pushes it back towards the fielder at mid on.
FOUR! Angled into the stumps, Upul makes room and drives it over the fielder at covers for his first runs. The ball races away to the boundary.
Upul Tharanga prods forward and defends it.
Wide! Angled down the leg side, Upul tries to clip it but he misses. Umpire signals it as a wide.
Floated outside off, Munaweera stays deep in his crease and runs it down towards the third man region for a triple. He played that really late.
Short and into the stumps, Dilshan cuts it straight to the fielder at point.

The players are back in the middle for the chase. Upul Tharanga and Dilshan Munaweera will open the innings for Sri Lanka. Australia will start with spin as Ashton Turner has been handed the new ball.
